audit.why: Even matchup at 51.17% over 1710 games. Annie holds levels 1-5 through banked Pyromania; Sylas grows in extended fights once Kingslayer's cooldown drops to 6s at rank 5 and Hijack is up more often.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 5.5/10 retained; early lane Annie, 2+ items Sylas.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text claimed Sylas 'needs a kill or takedown first' to use Hijack.
audit.why: Hijack (R) steals the enemy ultimate outright at level 6 — 80s cooldown at rank 1, 950 range, no takedown requirement. The real spike is that he copies Tibbers the moment you cast it.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike rewritten around Hijack's 80s cooldown and the fact his copy carries no stocked Pyromania.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sustain was repeatedly attributed to Petricite Burst (passive), including a fabricated 'Petricite Burst shield'.
audit.why: Petricite Burst is an attack-speed / empowered-attack passive with no shield and no healing. The heal is Kingslayer (W), 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, 400 range, and it only heals against champions — which is why anti-heal timing and trading near the wave both matter. Abscond/Abduct (E) is his only dash and only exit at 13/12/11/10/9s; once he recasts Abduct onto you he has no escape until it is back.
audit.corrected: Petricite Burst references replaced with Kingslayer plus its real cooldowns; Abscond/Abduct cooldown made concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart layers disagreed: phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while win[N] read Annie x6 then Sylas.
audit.why: Same row rendered two ways. The packet levelChart agrees with win[]; phases sides were the stale layer.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side flipped to match win[N] as one atomic group.

edits.after: Carry by saving Flash-Tibbers for his Abduct arrival — he lands beside you with no exit and a stocked stun ends it.

edits.before: If Sylas opens the score, reset expectations and respect Abscond / Abduct doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Sylas opens the score his Hijack copy of Tibbers starts hurting, so hold R rather than opening with it, farm with Q refunds, and let the banked stun keep him honest at chain range.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Abscond is his only escape — once he recasts Abduct onto you he is stuck for 13s. Commit there.

edits.before: Level 3 favors you because you can punish any Q-chain approach before his healing passive makes it safe
edits.after: Level 3 favors you: punish any Chain Lash approach before rank-1 Kingslayer's 12s heal makes trades safe

edits.before: Level 6 favors you still, since he needs to already have a kill to make Hijack dangerous and your combo out-damages his base kit
edits.after: Level 6 favors you still, since Hijack costs him 80s to copy Tibbers and your bear plus a stocked stun out-damages the copy

edits.before: Sylas has to walk his Q chains into your Disintegrate/Incinerate poke and Passive stun range, and you punish his all-in windows hard before he has the sustain from Petricite Burst to trade evenly.
edits.after: Sylas has to walk Chain Lash into your Disintegrate/Incinerate poke and Pyromania stun range, and you punish his all-ins hard before rank-3 Kingslayer's 9s heal lets him trade evenly with you.

edits.before: He can steal your Tibbers with Hijack, which is genuinely dangerous since a stolen bear fights alongside him, but he needs a kill or takedown first to even get the option, and you're still ahead in raw combo damage.
edits.after: He can steal your Tibbers with Hijack the moment he hits 6, and a stolen bear fights alongside him, but Hijack is 80s at rank 1 and his copy carries no stocked Pyromania, so you win the raw combo race.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are firmly yours because Sylas has to walk through your poke to start a Q chain, and your Passive stun into Tibbers punishes any all-in attempt long before his passive sustain makes trades safe for him, so you should be pressuring aggressively in this window.
edits.after: Levels 1-5 are firmly yours because Sylas has to walk through your poke to land Chain Lash, and a stocked Pyromania into Tibbers punishes any all-in long before Kingslayer's heal — 12s at rank 1 — makes trades safe for him, so pressure aggressively in this window.

edits.before: At level 6 the matchup gets trickier since he can Hijack your Tibbers if he's picked up a kill anywhere on the map, turning your own ultimate against you, but even then your base combo damage is still ahead of his unless he's already fed — keep pressuring rather than playing scared of the steal.
edits.after: At level 6 he can Hijack your Tibbers the instant you cast it — no kill required anywhere on the map — and turn your own ultimate around, but Hijack is 80 seconds at rank 1 and his copy arrives with no stocked Pyromania behind it, so keep pressuring on that cooldown instead of playing scared of the steal.

edits.before: Once Sylas reaches the late game with real items his dueling potential and sustain from Petricite Burst let him win extended fights that go past the first burst window, so past two items you want to end fights fast rather than trade with him at length.
edits.after: Once Sylas reaches the late game with real items his dueling potential and the Kingslayer heal — down to 6s at rank 5 — let him win fights that outlast your first burst, so past two items end fights fast rather than trade with him at length.

edits.after: Bait his Kingslayer heal before committing your full combo
